title: Power
description: The rack's draw, measured where a sensor reports it (the NUCs' RAPL) and estimated from published figures elsewhere, with every gap listed. docs/design/host-monitoring.md.

panels.title: Rack draw (measured + estimated)
panels.description: The NUCs' measured platform power (RAPL psys) plus the Pis' and Voyager's estimated draw. It mixes measured terms, estimates and one upper bound (Voyager's CPU), and leaves out what is not measured: Hubble, Voyager's board, memory, fans, HBA and power supply, and the Pis' USB drives are not measured and not included. It is neither a floor nor a ceiling on the real draw. Estimated: a published figure scaled by load, not a reading. Voyager's CPU term idles at a datasheet maximum, so it is an upper bound. docs/design/observability.md, "Power estimates", lists each figure and its source.

panels.title: Every host

NUCs are measured: CPU package and platform other (psys minus package: memory, NVMe drive, chipset, network) add up to the board's psys. Pis and Voyager are estimated: a Pi's whole board from its CPU use; Voyager's CPU from its CPU use and each disk from its busy time (its CPU idles at a datasheet maximum, so that column is an upper bound), and its memory is a fixed figure. Hubble is not measured. A blank cell is a part the host does not have or that is not measured.

panels.title: Not measured
panels.description: Draw that no sensor reports and no sourced figure estimates. The rack draw leaves it out.

options.content:
Not measured, so not in the rack draw:

1. **Wall input**: no smart plug or metered PDU, so power supply losses are unknown, the NUCs' bricks included.
2. **Hubble**: the router reports no power; its adapter is rated 45 W, an upper bound.
3. **Voyager board, chipset, fans, HBA and power supply**: no BMC, no sourced figure.
4. **Pi USB drives**: the Crucial P3 behind an RTL9210 bridge, at most 5 W each (its rated maximum); Crucial publishes no idle or active figure. The Pi estimate is the bare board.
5. **NUC NVMe drives on their own**: inside platform other, not separated. The WD Blue SN580s are rated 4 W at most; the XPG GAMMIX S20 has no published figure.
6. **GPU**: none present.
